purpose: Public deterministic controls demonstrating task-time applicability and candidate enforcement.

controls.title: Preserve source authority and uncertainty
controls.failure_message: A material state claim appears without evidence or uncertainty language.

controls.title: A logged failure must become a task-time control and candidate check
controls.failure_message: The learning claim does not connect the failure to control selection, candidate evaluation or same-class proof.

controls.title: Preserve the smallest verified public architecture
controls.forbidden_candidate_regex: (?i)(implemented|requires|ships with).*(vector database|graph database|Gmail ingestion|Calendar ingestion|self-modifying policy)
controls.failure_message: The candidate expands the verified release into a deliberately deferred capability.

controls.title: Keep structural, synthetic and live evidence distinct
controls.failure_message: An improvement or reliability claim appears without its evidence class.
